title: Documentation/repo alignment, session fixation (SEC-2026-001), grievance respondent list & autocomplete/profile-link safeguards
summary: Synced README, DEVELOPMENTGUIDE, FrameworksGuide, API_CONTRACT, and CHANGES with the code that actually ships (seeders, truncate_fresh_install, migration 038, operational API, SecurityAudit map, /api route index, removed obsolete script references). Documented DevelopmentHistory filenames as calendar dates (M.D.YYYY). Implemented session_regenerate_id(true) in Core\Auth::login() for password and 2FA web login; updated security audit SEC-2026-001 to remediated. Recorded legacy UserProfileController as unwired. Grievance respondent list: UNION includes inline non-registered grievances (respondent_id NULL) with PAPS and profile-derived names; per-row paps_yes_count/paps_no_count and GrievanceRespondent::formatIsPapsLabel() show mixed Yes/No in one cell (web + PDF). Grievance create: respondent /api/respondents/* calls deferred until first name has at least 3 characters (JS + ApiController); form hint text added. Respondent first/middle/last/history/latest APIs now include linked-profile name fallback (`profiles` via grievance/respondent profile_id), and docs now include new `database/seeders/seed_profiles.php`. Same release day: Grievance REST write parity and list filtering — POST /api/grievance/store|update|delete|restore, GET /api/grievance/list query alignment with web filters/export where applicable, App\Capabilities tweak, Grievance model/list/view soft-delete UX (see changes entry below).
